title: Introduction to the Type 1 Diabetes Knowledge Portal
summary: This Thursday, January 14th at 12pm EST, join our webinar to learn about type 1 diabetes and how the T1D Knowledge Portal will facilitate research into this disease.
bodyHtml:
This Thursday, January 14th at 12pm EST, join our webinar to learn about type 1 diabetes and how the T1D Knowledge Portal will facilitate research into this disease. Dr. Suna Onengut will present an overview of T1D and the progress to date on elucidating its genetics. Dr. Kyle Gaulton will talk about current work on translating T1D genetic signals into knowledge about effector genes and pathways. Then Noël Burtt from the Portal team will give a brief demonstration of the T1DKP and talk about how it will develop in the coming years. We hope to "see" you there!

Join the webinar
